items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy sent a telegram to New York to Shoebuck... he sent me out to Dayton, Ohio to probably come out and join his band

ctx.x: That time Wilcox was writing, Sy Oliver (inaudible) things were there, you know, Sy Oliver (inaudible) writing and all that stuff.
And those arrangements were really hard. So anyway, Jimmy sent a telegram to New York to Shoebuck, (inaudible) he would call him (inaudible).
So he says -- told Chu Berry, (inaudible) he sent me out to Dayton, Ohio to probably come out and join his band for two weeks -- two months, you know.
